external_collaboration.evidence_quote: B.E.A. (Buoy Eau Air) was a research collaboration between Divers Code Malta and the University of Malta’s Institute of Aerospace Technologies. The project investigated a coordinated system of vehicles operating in the air, on the surface and underwater to help monitor divers and warn them about hazards.
